title: EspressoLab grinder result
description: Output of `espressolab_cli grind`. The `distribution` object is exactly the shape a recipe's puck.grind takes, so it can be pasted across unchanged.
$comment: Kept synchronized with engine/grind/grinder_io.cpp's dump_result_json(). This is not a shot artifact: it carries no recipe hash, no coefficient hash, and no result hash, because the grinder is outside the shot pipeline.

bins.$comment: Same contract as recipe.puck.grind.bins: strictly increasing diameter and mass fractions summing to 1, both enforced by GrindDistribution::validate() rather than by this schema. Diameters are emitted at nanometre resolution so a re-saved document is byte-identical.

sauter_mean_diameter_um.description: d32. A recipe carrying this distribution requires it to fall in 150-800 um; a grinder spec is free to produce one outside that band, and the CLI says so.

mass_balance_residual.description: Largest deviation from unit mass across the passes. The population balance conserves mass exactly, so this is machine epsilon and exists to prove it.

provenance.description: Travels with the file so a document that outlives this repository still carries its own caveat.
